import json, resource, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
try:
    import psutil
except Exception:
    psutil=None
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent; mesh=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); prefix=root/'flow'
cmd=[str(Path.cwd()/'build/cartmesh2d_sst_rans_probe'),str(mesh),str(prefix),'flatplate-sweep','--nu','2e-7','--speed','1','--inlet-k','2.25e-7','--inlet-omega','125','--leading-edge','0','--max-iterations','20000','--completion-updates','500','--max-seconds','540','--scalar-preconditioner','ilu0']
start=time.time(); samples=[]; timeout=False; rss_limit=512*1024*1024; disk_floor=int(1.5*1024**3)
with (root/'stdout.log').open('wb') as out,(root/'stderr.log').open('wb') as err:
    p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=out,stderr=err); proc=psutil.Process(p.pid) if psutil else None
    while True:
        rc=p.poll(); elapsed=time.time()-start; rss=None
        if proc:
            try:rss=proc.memory_info().rss
            except psutil.Error:rss=None
        free=shutil.disk_usage(root).free; samples.append({'elapsedSeconds':elapsed,'rssBytes':rss,'diskFreeBytes':free})
        if free<disk_floor or (rss is not None and rss>rss_limit):p.kill();p.wait();rc=p.returncode;break
        if rc is not None:break
        if elapsed>=600:timeout=True;p.kill();p.wait();rc=p.returncode;break
        time.sleep(5)
end=time.time(); child_rss=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
result={'command':cmd,'startedAtEpoch':start,'endedAtEpoch':end,'runtimeSeconds':end-start,'exitCode':rc,'timeout':timeout,'peakRssBytes':child_rss,'peakRssSource':'resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN.ru_maxrss','liveRssGuardActive':psutil is not None,'rssLimitBytes':rss_limit,'diskFloorBytes':disk_floor,'samples':samples}
(root/'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');sys.exit(124 if timeout else (rc if rc is not None else 1))
